scope: Remaining H16 exact-owned stop cleanup and E5 finalization only; production funding unsupported, explicit fixture funding profile retained

reusable_source.fact: Two bounded convergent native pending scans across supported algo types, exact issuer/provider/lease/account/metadata, five-second issuance TTL. Inventory grants no cleanup permission; empty alone is not a terminal targeted readback.

Actual original protection claim/native ID, current canonical request/action/source bindings, full account claim inventory FP04/FP11 and protected lifecycle evidence. Reuse exact-owned identification, not flat-as-cancel authority. FP11 policy deliberately emits no cleanup target; flat+active protection remains contradiction/dependency.

Targeted original order-algo read parses ACTIVE/CANCELED/triggered-child uncertainty. CANCELED requires exact original native algo, no children and actualSz0; publishes actual canonical original stop OrderResult.CANCELED through existing dispatch outbox. Triggered child requires actual child order/fill reconciliation; no canceled shortcut.

Existing exact cancel-algos transport body is one-item list with only instId=BTC-USDT-SWAP and numeric algoId. Transport support is not owned cleanup authorization or a durable one-cancel claim. No TradingService cancellation owner/API or cancellation ACK parser demonstrated.

Existing single actual exit request, exact authority quantity, all real entry/exit fills/fees and canonical funding consumer yields TradeResultBuildOutcome. Dedicated closed transition alone authorizes CLOSED and exact original flat clock. No weakening for multiple requests/capped quantity.

Existing canonical writers include TRADE_RESULT, POSITION_PROJECTION and LIFECYCLE_EXECUTION_BINDING. TradeResult requires durable exact funding first; recover detects half-published CLOSED/result graphs, so final effects need durable replay before any next admission.

minimal_missing_cleanup.proposal: Trusted internal cleanup_owned_stop(stop_operation_id, *, flat_close_operation_id, metadata, proof, expected_revision), FIXTURE-first actual FakeProductProvider owner composition
minimal_missing_cleanup.preconditions: Exact actual flat close publication same original native posId, zero EXIT_REQUESTED canonical position, original plan/action/full exit fill truth. Original PROTECTION_STOP durable claim plus exact native algoId and original materialized algoClOrdId/action/position binding. Current issuer inventory and targeted read show that exact stop ACTIVE; all account claims complete/current, no competing ownership/unknown duplicate or triggered child. Final current guard fences process/provider/account/canonical flat/source/claim inventory again immediately before one specific cancel.
minimal_missing_cleanup.durability_gap: ProductDispatchJournal.prepare currently accepts only entry/protection/position-exit/emergency-exit prepared order intents; operation_id is original canonical order request ID. Reusing original stop claim would reconcile and not send cancel; inventing CANCEL OrderRequest would change shared contract. Add a narrowly typed E6-local cleanup phase/claim keyed by original stop operation/native ID+actual flat evidence, on existing dispatch connection/outbox. It must be independently durable before POST and replay read-only after ambiguity/crash. No blind second cancel/new ID; no general cancellation framework.
minimal_missing_cleanup.effect: Use only already-supported exact one-target cancel-algos body. Do not claim ACK proves cancellation. Response/lost-ACK/error leaves cleanup pending; always query original stop through existing reconcile and then fresh complete inventory to require exact terminal canceled/no triggered child and target absent. No extra POST during retry/recovery; preserve exact handle/claim even failure.
minimal_missing_cleanup.policy: Existing FP11 cleanup_target_ref=None is no cancellation authority. New small internal decision must explicitly establish unused exact-owned stop cleanup after proven original flat, preserving original-stop protection until flat. This is authorized local owner implementation work, not permission to clean unknown/external objects or cancel all.

finalization_seam.gates: Drain actual publication backlog. Require current exact flat EXIT_REQUESTED, original entry/close/stop claim chain, single-close consumer compatibility, every entry/order remainder and protection order terminal with targeted evidence plus fresh complete inventory. Funding owner actual canonical receipt matches original flat interval/plan/position and explicit fixture source. No source dictionaries/PASS/terminal flags supplied by API.
finalization_seam.e5: Recover actual original entry requests/fills, exact exit request/fills and E5 action; call build_trade_result(... final_position=actual current canonical flat, funding_evidence=actual persisted canonical funding). Call closed_transition with exact returned outcome. Build complete lifecycle execution binding including terminal stop and all actual order observations. Original broker flat timestamp stays unchanged; final local interpreted_at may be later, no fake fresh native observation.
finalization_seam.publication: Narrow typed finalization wrapper/outbox on existing E6 replay pattern, with exact flat publication hash, funding evidence ref/hash, cleanup terminal+inventory commitment, original source/action/plan and canonical graph. Effects contain real E5 closed projection/binding and TRADE_RESULT; durable funding already exists. Recheck complete graph/process/claim generation under writer boundary. Replay saved immutable effects after crash without provider calls or rebuilding different IDs/times. Partial publication blocks admission until recovered; do not raw-write CLOSED or insert a result directly.

test_first_flows: Current TradingFundingV02Tests.flat uses full entry->close but no genuine active protection. Existing TradingProtectionMonitorV02Tests.context reaches protection using partial entry with remainder pending. Do not splice them and ignore remainder: create joined helper using actual fully FILLED entry quantity, actual E5 protection builder/preparation/execute/readback/inventory->OPEN_PROTECTED, then actual explicit close/partial/flat and funding. This avoids new entry-remainder cancellation semantics for first H16 sample.

Before flat, cleanup must deny without POST and original protection remains actual ACTIVE. At actual flat, exact owned active stop may receive one single-target cancel; ACK-only or empty inventory does not finalize. Targeted CANCELED readback plus complete postcancel inventory allows terminal cleanup proof.

Wrong/external algo ID, duplicate/unknown account claim, copied/stale inventory, original source mutation or second-connection claim at final boundary -> no cancel. Triggered child path invokes existing reconciliation and denies single-close finalization if added exit fills/requests violate consumer.

Lost cancel ACK/crash after committed cleanup claim -> successor real lease recovery only original GET/readback, no second cancel POST; terminal outbox publication failure replay exact effects, no invented terminal state.

Actual canonical funding + terminal stop + zero current position -> real build_trade_result/closed_transition produces one canonical TradeResult/CLOSED with original flat clock and full binding; repeated call returns same receipt and no new lifecycle revision/provider effect.

No funding/incomplete source, active stop, stale targeted evidence, unsettled entry remainder, foreign interval, unsupported fees, changed allocation or multiple exit requests must retain EXIT_REQUESTED/no result. Fail after each final effect and recover identical saved batch.
constraints: No shared canonical schema change, no generic financial defaults, no Paper zero substitute, no flat=>stop-gone inference. Ordinary Windows Paper and its existing PaperBroker-only cleanup path remain untouched. No actual provider/production ledger verification claim.
